run_linear_crf_training: run the linear chain CRF training loop with SGD to learn potentials and transitions
build_crf_transition_graph: build a bigram transition graph for a linear chain CRF with a given number of classes
build_crf_potential_graph: build a unary potential graph for a linear chain CRF with given features and classes
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a linear chain CRF model using viterbi decoding and random inputs
compute_crf_loss: compute the negative log likelihood loss for a linear chain CRF given input and target sequences
